en.headline: Work-week outlook: unsettled with showers and possible tropical cyclone signals
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects cloudy conditions with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms early to midweek as Tropical Storm Narra edges closer to western Guangdong, with very hot weather returning later in the week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory’s latest nine-day forecast indicates that a broad trough of low pressure will continue to affect the southern China coast in the coming days, keeping weather unsettled. Tropical Storm Narra is expected to linger near Beibu Wan today and tomorrow before turning northeast later on Monday or Tuesday toward the vicinity of Leizhou Peninsula.

On Monday, cloudy skies with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms are forecast, with south to southwest winds of force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground later. Temperatures will range from 27 to 31 degrees Celsius. Tuesday and Wednesday are expected to remain cloudy with showers and thunderstorms, heavier at times on Tuesday, and windier conditions possible offshore and on high ground.

The Observatory said it will closely monitor Narra’s movement and local wind changes and assess the need for tropical cyclone warning signals on Tuesday or Wednesday. From Thursday, showers are expected to ease with sunny intervals, while Friday should see sunny periods and very hot conditions with maximum temperatures around 33 degrees. The public is advised to stay updated on the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 下周展望：初中期不穩定有驟雨 或發熱帶氣旋警告
zh.dek: 天文台預料受廣闊低壓槽及熱帶風暴紫檀影響，下周初至中期多雲有驟雨及狂風雷暴，風勢較大，稍後轉酷熱。
body: 香港天文台最新九天天氣預報指出，一道廣闊低壓槽會在未來數日持續影響華南沿岸，天氣不穩定。熱帶風暴紫檀預料今日及明日於北部灣一帶徘徊，其後在周一稍後至周二逐漸轉向東北移動，靠近雷州半島至廣東西部沿岸。
周一大致多雲，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴，吹南至西南風4至5級，稍後高地間中達6級，氣溫27至31度。周二及周三繼續多雲有驟雨及雷暴，周二部分時間驟雨較大，離岸及高地風勢較大。
天文台表示會密切監察紫檀的路徑及本港風勢變化，評估於周二或周三發出熱帶氣旋警告信號的需要。周四起驟雨減少，日間有陽光，周五大致天晴，日間酷熱，最高氣溫約33度。市民應留意最新天氣消息。
